dialogue: Delivered? The road,  yes, the road is still bad. But everything else,  more or less. Look, nobody is perfect.
You want perfect, go to Singapore. Here, we work with what we have.
He looks away, arranging something behind the counter.
You know Nandadasa has been in that Grama Sevaka office since 1994. Thirty years. You would think a man in the same room for thirty years would run out of things to look at. He never has.

options.consequence: He does not explain what he means. But he has given you a piece of the puzzle regarding Nandadasa and the road.
